tool.help:
**AlphaFold 3 Server - FREE Structure Prediction**
Use DeepMind's AlphaFold 3 for FREE via their web server.
**Limits:** - 20 jobs per day - No API key required - Results via email
**Website:** https://alphafoldserver.com
**Supported Molecules:** - Proteins - DNA - RNA - Ligands (small molecules) - Ions - Modified residues
**How to Use:** 1. Run this tool to format your input 2. Go to alphafoldserver.com 3. Sign in with Google 4. Submit the formatted sequences 5. Download results when ready
**Input Formats:** - FASTA file with protein/DNA/RNA sequences - AlphaFold 3 JSON specification
**Output:** - mmCIF structure file - Confidence scores
**License:** Free for non-commercial use
**Citation:** Abramson et al. (2024). Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions. Nature.
